content: Starting research into app stack, existing build/run scripts, release build commands, and current pi-coding-agent dependency versions.

observation: Project is a pnpm workspace with @pi-mobile/host and @pi-mobile/app. Physical devices need a LAN/Tailscale-reachable host URL and PI_MOBILE_HOST_BIND=0.0.0.0 on the host; simulator localhost only works on the Mac.
Mobile app exposes ios/android scripts using Expo run commands. A release iOS device build can be invoked via Expo CLI with --configuration Release and --device.
Expo CLI supports `expo run:ios --configuration Release --device [device]`; help describes Release as production unsigned and `--device` as device name or UDID.
iOS bundle is ai.botisan.PiMobile and the native project has DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=NFKM5YQJD7, so release device builds should be signed for the configured Apple team.
@pi-mobile/host currently depends on @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 0.74.0 while npm latest is 0.75.3; an upgrade is needed.
The PR already has staged iOS/native/package changes and unstaged edits in the generated Xcode project/Info.plist. Dependency update must avoid resetting or unstaging those existing changes.

content: Research complete. Current host dependency is behind npm latest, and Expo CLI's release-to-device path is `expo run:ios --configuration Release --device` from the mobile workspace. Upgrading @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent in @pi-mobile/host from 0.74.0 to npm latest 0.75.3 using pnpm so package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml stay consistent.
